“Stationed here” preserves the location from context without changing the point.

“Famous for its pride” and “such a thing” preserve the source’s characterization.

The shortened hesitation and omission of “just now” do not change the retraction.

“Following us unseen” preserves the secret pursuit and their eventual disappearance.
“That timing made sense” preserves the narrator’s assessment.

“Man” naturally preserves the reference to what sort of person his Master is.
“A surprisingly soft side” preserves the unexpected gentleness without changing the characterization.
The recast preserves that Jeok Cheongang cares for him and that this explains the lack of serious trouble.
The hesitation and decision to let him see for himself remain intact.
The narrator’s concerns are stated in H057; deleting this setup loses no content.

“Unpleasant possibilities” preserves the narrator’s apprehension.
The active construction preserves the same suspected attack by Dark Heaven.

The recast keeps the circling thoughts and the cottage’s location in the Rear Court.

Repeating “martial artist” makes the comparison explicit without changing its meaning.
The source addresses him as an elder; SOL drops that hierarchy cue.

The recast preserves the silent look and eventual break in the silence.
